scope: One isolated diagnostic decoder; no source or GPU approval in this record.
useful_missing_evidence: The retained exact 97af official profiles contain durations and abbreviated kernel identities, not CUDA function resources.
Retained standalone MoE resource captures do not establish exact decoder M1 resources: MULDEC and FINPF flags differ.
Exact selected SK2 resources can constrain a later architecture feasibility analysis without another speculative numerical rewrite.

compliance_basis.local_task: muse_decode_layer/TASK.md explicitly allows print diagnostics and returns the last 16000 characters, while prohibiting input work moved into prepare, harness access and timing tampering.
compliance_basis.inference: Read-only host CUDA attribute and occupancy diagnostics are consistent with that allowance when all device math, flags, launches, tuning and input processing remain unchanged.

required_before_frozen_source_review: Write the exact small-MoE allocation into the plan: at most six eligible small builds, each at most 320 bytes including schema and overflow, total 1920 bytes; no MAIN query.
Disable reporting before every prepare and arm only after existing tuning, PIN_PICK, attention self-test and guard checks; new lazy extensions inherit the current arm state.
Report only a real post-prepare SK2 dispatch after the cap-only return, using the exact existing kernel pointer and actual dynamic shared memory.
Preserve full specialization identity including PK, FUSE, BND and runtime UV mode, pmax, physical dimensions and PDL; changed pmax or shared size must remain distinct.
Keep output, dedup storage and query work bounded after overflow; SK2 ceiling is 8192 bytes including header and overflow.
Keep every device function, numerical define, compiler flag, original launch, packing helper, selector and autotuner unchanged after removing only approved host additions.
CPU proof must cover generated BND/UV source, new no-op fallback binding, lifecycle, lazy modules, dedup identity, query errors and worst-case formatting/budget exhaustion.
official_evidence_gate: Root alone may authorize and run one private check after final source review.
Retain exact candidate hash, terminal receipt and full available log tail; identify successful versus unavailable per-API results.
Match retained identities to actual dispatched configurations; missing, error or overflow records remain unknown.
CL greater than one block occupancy is not cluster occupancy; report this limitation.
Correctness failure ends the diagnostic attempt; an incomplete log does not authorize an automatic retry.
The diagnostic score cannot justify promotion, a performance claim or an identical noise-seeking retry.
limits: Host queries and formatting can add eager or capture host overhead; unchanged replay source does not establish identical cubins or identical check timing.
Function attributes do not establish achieved occupancy, dynamic spill traffic, stalls, escape-warp latency or absence of WGMMA serialization.
Local storage equal to zero or capacity equal to one alone does not establish a useful rewrite mechanism.
Fresh unchanged tuning can select different configurations from the earlier public run.
Read-only CUDA queries may report previous asynchronous errors; a nonzero status is not uniquely attributable to the query.
